p: who were cobblers in Eretz Yisrael,

and they would sit in the marketplace of prostitutes and fashion shoes for prostitutes. And the prostitutes would enter
did not raise their eyes to look at … swore, … as follows:
did not raise their eyes to look at the women. And those prostitutes were so impressed with this behavior that when they swore, they would say as follows:
By the lives of the holy Sages of Eretz Yisrael.
g: שנה התנא את הברייתא הזו לפני רבא ורב ספרא
והיו יושבים בשוק של הזונות ועושים מנעלים לזונות והזונות נכנסות אליהם
שהן, הזונות, היו מסתכלות בהם, והם, החכמים, לא היו מרימים את עיניהם להסתכל בהן

p: The Holy One, … Blessed be He, … loves three
The Holy One, Blessed be He, loves three
One who does not get angry; … one who does not get drunk; … and one who is forgiving.
One who does not get angry; one who does not get drunk; and one who is forgiving.
The Holy One, … Blessed be He, … hates three … One who says one … with his mouth and … another in his heart,
The Holy One, Blessed be He, hates three people: One who says one statement with his mouth and means another in his heart,
one who knows testimony about another
and does not testify on his behalf;
and one who observes a licentious matter

p: and Zigud came alone to testify about him before Rav Pappa.
Tuveya sinned and Zigud is lashed,
“One witness shall not rise up against a man”
and you testified against him alone.
You have merely given him a bad reputation.

p: But is one permitted to hate
“You shall not hate your brother in your heart”
where there are witnesses that he performed a sin.
to a case like this, … when he saw him … a licentious matter?
to a case like this, when he saw him perform a licentious matter?

p: “The fear of God is to hate evil”
to … tell his teacher … he … will hate him?
to whether one who saw someone sin may tell his teacher so that he too will hate him?
trusted by his teacher as two … he … tell him,
trusted by his teacher as two witnesses, and therefore his statement will be accepted, he should tell him,
